boundary: DDB membership supplies candidates. Current main DV000004 enumerates them and conditionally resolves ECU aliases; DV000005 performs a separately requested connectivity check. Support-plugin queries consume live/cached state. Operation execution and mutation authorization remain separate.

connection_algorithm.scope: connection helper used by conditional alias postprocessing and explicit connection callers
steps: transmit the database send frame through the common communication cache/direct sender
AND returned bytes with the database receive mask
compare the masked result byte-for-byte with the database receive-check bytes
return the connection result to the caller, which decides whether to remove an alternative

alias_postprocessing.effect: probe an individual category; remove mutually exclusive alternatives from the result
alias_postprocessing.gate: combined category 462/463 and at least one corresponding individual category coexist

current_main_dv4.binding_scope: main-product explicit initial Gen/Spe context; exact query retained per region

current_na_camry.meaning: all current Camry-HV install rows declare connection frame 0 / CommSet 9 and route-selector byte 0x12 or 0x22; all 34 candidate category+route-selector keys resolve in the raw class-0x10D route table. Frame 0 has empty send/mask/check variables.

plugin_contract.cache_only: CheckCarCable succeeds and (its output is 1 or route selector is 0x15): ConnectCheckNoComm
plugin_contract.match: first Installing row matching requested ECU and encoded route selector
plugin_contract.missing_row: success with no ECU output; the adapter omits connect
plugin_contract.otherwise: ConnectCheck receives route selector and Category +0x48 generation separately

individual_connection.response: connect is the signed byte at CCmdEcuInfo+0x20, emitted only for exactly one record

transport_route.address_extension: u8 +0x0A; consumed by the current P5 frame builder. Current selector-0x22 Camry rows use it to distinguish logical categories that share request CAN ID 0x750
transport_route.legislated_request_address: u16 +0x14; current masters contain standard 0x7E0..0x7E7 physical OBD request IDs here. The corresponding 11-bit response is request+8; +0x14 is not itself the response ID.

did_root.group_bitmap: MSB-first; set bit n means xx01+n; final bit for next xx00 is skipped
did_root.group_request: replace request DID with supported xx00 group
did_root.root_bitmap: MSB-first; set bit n means group (n << 8)

pipeline.semantics: CSelectCarTypeVin10 dispatches by communication generation. P3/P4 use CDbVehicleDecisionTable; current P5 (generation-low5 20/21) uses CDbVinVehicleDecisionTable and its Phase5 vehicle-decision virtual returns 0xC0040101 without querying class 0x129; results feed vehicle/install resolution
enumerate selected install rows with connection flag -1; only the final mutually exclusive ECU-alias branches may probe connectivity and remove alternatives
explicit groupId/ecuId/busId request; only a one-record response emits the signed connect flag
optionId 1/2/3 dispatches to CCommCachePlusP5::CheckSupportPid/Did/Rid; support requires live/cached communication state beyond DDB presence
